A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 42-page versions of Social Story Frames, with corresponding main sections and Appendices A-J. Text, equations, figures and tables support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original human plausibility ratings, expert classification evaluations, context ablations and analyses of 6,140 Reddit stories (Sections 4-6; Appendices D-I).

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including model validation, human judgments of narrative similarity and analyses of community storytelling practices.

M1.justification: The taxonomy, context summarization, generator/classifier pipeline, LoRA training procedures and ssf-sim construction are unchanged (Sections 3-6; Appendices C, E, G and H). The Llama citation's changed author name does not indicate a model change.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same SSF-CORPUS and its split and stratified variants, with unchanged Reddit community coverage, English-language tasks and U.S. participant populations.

E2.justification: The same GPT-4o/SSF-GENERATOR comparison (Figure 3), GPT-4.1/SSF-CLASSIFIER comparison (Table 1), and Sentence-BERT semantic-similarity comparator (Section 6 and Appendix H) are retained.

E3.justification: Data splits, unseen-community holdouts, preprocessing, annotation sample sizes, training budgets, evaluation metrics and context-ablation procedures remain unchanged (Sections 4-5; Appendices D-H).

E4.justification: Both retain the same summarization and model error analyses, community/conversation context ablations, ssf-sim validation and illustrative story-pair analyses. Renumbered appendix tables contain existing analyses.

E5.justification: Agreement measures, plotted error bars and one-sided paired t-tests with Holm-Bonferroni correction are unchanged (Figure 6; Appendices D.4, F.3, G.3 and H.2). No run-count, seed or uncertainty-reporting changes appear.

E6.justification: Numerical and qualitative findings match throughout, including Table 1, the 74% versus 52% similarity-validation result, and the context-ablation values in v1 Table 7/v2 Table 6. Demographic and human-written inference comparison values also remain unchanged despite table renumbering.

T1.justification: The formal dataset definitions in Appendix D.2, MMR equation in G.1, and ssf-sim definitions and derivations in H.1 are unchanged. Terminology edits in related work do not revise mathematical definitions or assumptions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: a ten-dimensional reader-response formalism, distilled models, human validation and comparative analyses of community narrative practices.

C2.justification: Interpretations of context effects, community similarity and narrative diversity remain unchanged. Section 9 and the appendices retain the same applicability boundaries, summarization limitations, failure explanations and small-scale global-validation caveat.

D1.justification: Prompt templates, annotation instructions, hyperparameters, decoding settings and the approximately 100 A6000 GPU-hour budget are retained. The code, dataset and model access links also remain identical.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are retained. Changes such as Dubey to Grattafiori for The Llama 3 Herd of Models, revised Boyd metadata and updated publication venues concern the same works.

P1.justification: Section 2 revises story-content/context terminology, including storyworld/taleworld to taleworld/storyrealm. Bibliographic spelling, author, year and publication details are corrected or completed. The section organization and substantive narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 3 and the demographic table receive cleaner rules and spacing. v1's duplicate demographic captions, labeled Tables 4 and 5, become a single Table 4 caption in v2; subsequent tables and references are renumbered. Figures and underlying table content are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 removes the confusing duplicate demographic-table caption, improves table formatting, and repairs typographical and incomplete bibliographic entries. These changes modestly improve readability and reference traceability. The scientific methods, evidence, claims and limitations remain unchanged.
